be unique to: This kind of black bear is unique to Taiwan; you cannot find it anywhere else in the world.
這種黑熊為台灣所獨有；你在世界上其他地方都找不到牠。
a unique opportunity: Studying abroad for a year gave her a unique opportunity that most students in her town never had.
出國留學一年給了她一個她鎮上大多數學生從未有過的獨一無二的機會。
a unique style: The singer has a unique style, mixing traditional Taiwanese music with modern rock in every song.
這位歌手擁有獨特的風格，每首歌都融合傳統台灣音樂和現代搖滾。
unique features: One of the unique features of this phone is a camera that can take clear photos underwater.
這支手機的獨有的特色之一是能在水下拍出清晰照片的相機。
a unique selling point: The café's unique selling point is that every cup of coffee is served by a friendly robot.
這家咖啡廳的獨特賣點是每杯咖啡都由友善的機器人送上。
universal suffrage: Under universal suffrage, every adult citizen has the right to vote, no matter how rich or poor.
在普選權之下，每位成年公民無論貧富都有投票權。
universal truths: The old story teaches universal truths, such as honesty and kindness, that people of every culture accept.
這個古老故事教導普世真理，例如誠實與仁慈，這是每個文化的人都接受的。
universal health care: Thanks to universal health care, almost every person in Taiwan can see a doctor at a low cost.
多虧全民健保，台灣幾乎每個人都能以低廉費用看醫生。
a universal language: Music is often called a universal language because people everywhere can enjoy it without words.
音樂常被稱為通用語言，因為各地的人不需要文字就能欣賞它。
universal appeal: Cartoons about friendship have universal appeal, loved by children and adults in every country.
關於友誼的卡通具有普遍的吸引力，受到各國兒童和成人喜愛。
universal values: Respect for human life and freedom are universal values shared by people all over the world.
尊重人命與自由是全世界人們共享的普世價值。
an unprecedented level: Air pollution in the city reached an unprecedented level last winter, higher than ever recorded before.
去年冬天該市的空氣污染達到史無前例的程度，比以往任何紀錄都高。
an unprecedented crisis: The sudden virus caused an unprecedented crisis, closing schools and shops across the world for the first time.
這突如其來的病毒造成空前的危機，首次使全世界的學校和商店關閉。
on an unprecedented scale: The floods destroyed homes on an unprecedented scale, affecting more people than any disaster in history.
洪水以前所未有的規模摧毀房屋，影響的人數超過歷史上任何災難。
It is unprecedented for…: It is unprecedented for a high school student to win this award; no teenager has ever done it before.
高中生贏得這個獎是空前的；從來沒有青少年做到過。
urban areas: More and more young people are leaving the countryside to find jobs in urban areas like Taipei.
越來越多年輕人離開鄉村，到像台北這樣的都市地區找工作。
urban planning: Good urban planning gives a city enough parks, bus lines, and bike paths for everyone who lives there.
良好的都市規劃讓城市有足夠的公園、公車路線和自行車道給每位居民。
urban sprawl: Because of urban sprawl, new houses and shopping malls have covered the farmland around the city.
由於都市無序擴張，新房屋和購物中心已覆蓋城市周圍的農田。
urban renewal: The old train station was rebuilt as part of an urban renewal project to bring life back downtown.
舊火車站作為都市更新計畫的一部分被重建，以讓市中心恢復活力。
urban legends: Many urban legends about ghosts in the old hospital spread quickly online, though none of them are true.
許多關於舊醫院鬧鬼的都市傳說在網路上迅速流傳，雖然沒有一個是真的。
urban decay: After the factories closed, the area suffered urban decay, with empty buildings and broken windows everywhere.
工廠關閉後，該地區遭遇都市衰敗，到處都是空屋和破窗。
an urgent message: The nurse received an urgent message telling her to go to the emergency room immediately.
護士收到一則緊急訊息，要她立刻前往急診室。
be in urgent need of: After the earthquake, thousands of families were in urgent need of food, water, and shelter.
地震後，數千個家庭急需食物、水和住所。
urgent action: Scientists warn that urgent action is needed now to stop the ice at the North Pole from melting.
科學家警告現在需要緊急行動以阻止北極的冰融化。
a matter of urgent concern: The rising number of traffic accidents near schools is a matter of urgent concern for parents.
學校附近交通事故數量上升是家長們迫切需要關注的事。
an urgent appeal: The hospital made an urgent appeal for blood donors after a serious bus accident on the highway.
在高速公路發生嚴重公車事故後，醫院發出緊急呼籲尋求捐血者。
a vacant position: The company posted an ad online to fill a vacant position after its accountant left last month.
這家公司在網路上刊登廣告，以填補會計上個月離職後的空缺的職位。
a vacant seat: The bus was crowded, but I finally found a vacant seat near the back and sat down.
公車很擁擠，但我終於在後面找到一個空位坐下。
a vacant expression: When the teacher asked him a question, he just looked up with a vacant expression, clearly not listening.
當老師問他問題時，他只是抬頭露出茫然的表情，顯然沒在聽。
a vacant lot: The children used to play baseball on a vacant lot where nothing had been built for years.
孩子們以前常在一塊多年沒有蓋任何建築的空地上打棒球。
vacant possession: The buyer asked for vacant possession, so the old tenants had to move out before he got the keys.
買家要求交屋時無人居住，所以舊房客必須在他拿到鑰匙前搬出。
a vacant stare: After hearing the bad news, she sat by the window with a vacant stare, saying nothing for hours.
聽到壞消息後，她坐在窗邊呆滯的凝視著，好幾個小時一句話也不說。
